exact: viral penetration via host endosomal membrane disruption by virus
viral penetration via perforation of host organellar membrane by virus
viral penetration via permeabilization of host organellar membrane
related: viral entry into host cell via permeabilization of host organelle membrane

definition: Induction of organellar membrane permeabilization triggered by an interaction between the host membrane and a membrane-penetration protein associated with a viral capsid. Results in release of the virus contents from an organelle into the host cell cytoplasm.
label: Viral penetration via permeabilization of host organellar membrane
